diagnosis: The public-sanitized ingress bridge is now proven in production, but the proof currently depends on a worker-specific one-shot workflow. Leaving that as the only executable regression path would force later workers to rebuild the same probe and risks duplicate request IDs if the workflow is reused. Existing mirror-atomic-append work is separate and must not be duplicated.
intervention: Materialized one non-duplicate SYSTEM_MULTIPLIER job to turn the successful G7 probe into a reusable bounded regression harness under existing owners, with unique request IDs, no ordinary-push trigger, exact durable-ref validation, one real proof run, and retirement of the ephemeral G7 workflow after proof.
